description: Shortlist Italian current accounts using website filters and ordinary comparable management fees. Default: fee ascending, 10 results, Italian links. Product eligibility still applies. Fee is not total cost; a conditional waiver is not an unconditional free account. Use get_product for fee waivers and richer terms. Only listed filters are supported.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

max_monthly_fee_eur.description: Maximum comparable ordinary management fee, excluding other charges; unknown prices do not match.

providers.description: Exact provider IDs from results; unknown IDs are rejected.

required_features.description: All must be explicitly true. Conditional zero availability does not mean an unconditional free account.

name: search_current_accounts
